name: Wallet Account
description: One on-chain account: its event ledger, scan cursor, backfill progress and latest native balance.

global.schema:
type WalletAccountState {
  address: String!
  chainId: Int!
  label: String
  ignored: Boolean!
  ledger: [LedgerEvent!]!
  cursor: ScanCursor
  backfill: BackfillState
  nativeBalance: NativeBalance
  bitcoinXpub: String
}

type LedgerEvent {
  id: OID!
  eventIdentifier: String!
  sequenceIndex: Int!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  type: EventType!
  subtype: EventSubtype!
  asset: String!
  amount: String!
  counterparty: String
  counterpartyLabel: String
  notes: String
  ignored: Boolean!
  source: EventSource!
  importBatch: String
}

type ScanCursor {
  lastLogsBlock: Int
  lastNativeScanBlock: Int
  lastEventTimestamp: DateTime
  lastRunAt: DateTime
}

type BackfillState {
  state: BackfillPhase!
  startBlock: Int
  nextBlock: Int
}

type NativeBalance {
  amount: String!
  blockNumber: Int!
  observedAt: DateTime!
}

enum EventType {
  SPEND
  RECEIVE
  TRADE
  TRANSFER
  STAKING
  MIGRATE
  INFORMATIONAL
}

enum EventSubtype {
  NONE
  FEE
  APPROVE
  WITHDRAWAL
  BLOCK_PRODUCTION
  SPAM
  AIRDROP
  DONATE
  DEPOSIT_ASSET
  REMOVE_ASSET
}

enum EventSource {
  CHAIN
  MANUAL
}

enum BackfillPhase {
  IDLE
  LOGS
  NATIVE
  DONE
}
global.initialValue: {"address": "", "chainId": 0, "label": null, "ignored": false, "ledger": [], "cursor": null, "backfill": null, "nativeBalance": null, "bitcoinXpub": null}
